tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for every section; warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Alternate section ground, to separate bands of content without a rule.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces sitting on linen: cards, form fields. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: honey-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tint wash behind a highlighted block or badge. Walnut and ink-muted text read on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: walnut
tokens.usage: Logo brown and primary ink. Body and heading text on paper, linen, paper-raised and honey-soft (12.6:1 on paper). Also the fill of dark sections and primary buttons.

tokens.name: walnut-deep
tokens.usage: Footer ground and pressed state of walnut buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, meta, footnotes. On paper (6.2:1), linen (5.6:1) and honey-soft (5.5:1).

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Link text and hover tint on light grounds (5.5:1 on paper, 4.9:1 on linen). Not for long body copy.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: The tree-ring tan from the logo. Accent fill, the ring motif, and text or icons on walnut grounds (8.2:1). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: Mid wood tone from the ring lines. Decorative lines and the ring motif on light grounds; only large text (24px+) on paper.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The one green, a teeny accent: a certification dot, a small icon, an underline. On light grounds only (5.4:1 on paper). Never a fill larger than a badge.

tokens.name: moss-light
tokens.usage: Moss when it sits on walnut grounds (6.9:1). Same rule: accents only.

tokens.name: on-walnut
tokens.usage: Text and logo on walnut and walnut-deep (12.6:1 and 15.5:1).

tokens.name: on-walnut-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on walnut (7.8:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Dark rust for form errors on light grounds: error text, the error icon and the 2px border of an invalid field. 6.9:1 on paper-raised, 6.5:1 on paper, 5.8:1 on linen. Always paired with an icon and words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: error-on-walnut
tokens.usage: Light rust for error messages shown on the walnut contact panel (6.8:1 on walnut, 8.4:1 on walnut-deep). Same rule: text plus icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on paper, linen, paper-raised and honey-soft: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: focus-on-walnut
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring inside walnut sections (8.2:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero headline, once per page. 48px/52px under 720px wide.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers on the landing page. 36px/42px on mobile.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Wooden bicycles, shaped by hand in Greece.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display or heading-1. One per section.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines to measure (64ch).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading. Set in ink-muted or grain on light grounds, honey on walnut.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: The one editorial voice: pull quotes, the biophilia definition. Max once per screen.

styles.name: quote-sm
styles.sample: To be close to natural life.
styles.usage: Photo captions with a voice, short asides.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside badges and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; eyebrow to heading.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; heading to lead.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero padding and the breathing room around the biophilia quote.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields, focus rings.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, small photos.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large photos and dark section panels: soft like the logo's terminals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, the language switcher.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: The only shadow: a raised card or a floating header on scroll. Most surfaces are flat.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for body text.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height on desktop (64px on mobile).
